title: Optimizing parameters for multiband ABRs to continuous speech
description: EEG dataset of multiband auditory brainstem responses (ABRs) derived from continuous 'peaky' speech, collected to identify optimal stimulus parameters. Experiment 1 compares zero-phase and chirp-phase speech profiles in normal-hearing adults, and Experiment 2 compares narrators with different fundamental frequencies (natural versus shifted to 100 Hz). Data include raw BrainVision EEG recordings, event files, and HDF5 stimulus and regressor files for deconvolution.
methods_description: Normal-hearing young adults listened to audiobook-based multiband peaky speech (dichotic, audiological bands) in a sound-isolating booth at about 65 dB SPL via ER-2 insert earphones, while EEG was recorded with BrainVision. Stimuli were presented in 10 s trials using custom expyfun Python scripts. Trials of different conditions were randomly interleaved, and triggers encoded condition, trial number and stimulus file.
